selection: Single Bplus baseline fixed_lab, complete complex response matrix with known charge calibration and independent unknown factorized axial source/readout transfers
selection_reason: Large pilot separation with fewer physical controls; cross/aa amplitude6.05%, greater than B0 baseline1.82%; q/mu expansion alone retains subpercent diagonal ambiguity. This does not select by higher/noise outcomes.
matrix_transform: Y=diag(1,d) chi diag(1,s); d,s nonzero complex functions of condition and frequency. No arbitrary elementwise transfer. Axial source preparation is required.
primary_estimators: cc and cross product F=W_model Yaa-YcaYac
selected raw-matrix LS with complex factorized source/readout gains

held_out_parameter_tests.note: New parameter combinations on existing prior bare data; not newly blind collected data

noise.scale: Complex RMS per raw matrix sample is multiplier times L2(physical chi_aa)/sqrt(N). Four entries independent circular Gaussian; real/imag SD=complex RMS/sqrt2.
noise.weight: Fixed clean-reference noise scales for synthetic comparison, not inferred experimental uncertainty
noise.gains: d=.7 exp(.4i)(1+.1x), s=1.3 exp(-.25i)(1+.1ix), x=(omega-mean)/ptp; same gains act on all corresponding entries

numerical_comparison: coarse/fine models versus identical higher reference for4 datasets, including Ua8 control; report relative L2/RMS separately from old scaled kernel metric
reporting_criteria: Report all outcomes, empirical bias and Ua4/16 discrimination vs truth8, with no new PASS threshold or continuum error bound. Report failure at weak coupling/high common absolute noise.
limits: Known bare Pi and operator basis assumed
eta used only in separate robustness tests, not joint experimental knob
Prior data already available; new split is analytical validation, not blinded measurement
No microscopic material source, continuum or magnetic transverse certification
No global parameter optimum or experimental statistical CI
